declaration.doc: Atomically load Skills; returns committed state for the following request.

parameters.name: skills
parameters.description: JSON array of Skill IDs; atomic update

declaration.doc: Atomically release non-base Skills; returns committed state for the following request.

parameters.name: skills
parameters.description: JSON array of Skill IDs; atomic update

declaration.doc: Start a foreground goal when none is active. End an existing foreground goal before starting another.

parameters.name: skills
parameters.description: Optional JSON array of initial foreground Skill IDs

declaration.doc: Finish foreground only; background completion belongs to its executor. continueDecision requires a remaining new goal.

parameters.name: continueDecision
parameters.description: Continue only to a different goal still requested by this user input; omit after ordinary completion

declaration.doc: Relay the user's request, reply or correction to a peer Agent. The receiver decides how to handle it.

parameters.name: text
parameters.description: User request, reply, correction or stop request
